name: Gemini
scope: The Gemini app with a personal Google Account, for adults, as described in Google's Gemini Apps Privacy Hub and help pages. Work and school accounts follow different terms.

activity.title: Manage & delete your history in Gemini Apps

training.summary: Google says a setting called "Chat content including text & attachments" is on by default for adults, and that while it is on, Google uses the content of your future chats to train generative AI models. Turning it off stops this for future chats unless you send feedback.

evidence.quote: "Chat content including text & attachments" is on by default if you are over 18.
Google uses the content of your future chats to train generative AI models.
Your future chats won’t be used to train generative AI models, unless you provide feedback.
Your Gemini settings don’t control processing of your chats to create anonymized data to improve Google services.

training.note: Google says its Gemini settings do not control the processing of chats to create anonymized data, and that chats reviewed by people are kept for up to 3 years even if you turn the setting off later.

retention.summary: Google says Gemini history is auto-deleted after 18 months by default, adjustable to 3 or 36 months or never. It says chats that human reviewers have looked at are kept for up to three years, even if you delete them.

evidence.quote: By default, your Gemini history older than 18 months is auto-deleted. You can turn off Auto-delete or change the auto-delete period to 3 or 36 months.

Chats reviewed by human reviewers (and related data like your language, device type, location info, or feedback) are not deleted when you delete your history. Instead, they are retained for up to three years.

deletion.summary: Google says you can delete your Gemini chats at any time and that removal starts immediately. The documents we read do not say when removal is complete, and say reviewed chats are not deleted with your history.

evidence.quote: You can also manually delete your Gemini Apps chats anytime.
When you choose to delete history manually or history is deleted automatically, we immediately start the process of removing it from the product and our systems.

human_review.summary: Google says human reviewers, including service providers, review a subset of chats to help improve its services. It says that whatever your settings, chats are used to protect Google, its users and the public with help from human reviewers.

evidence.quote: A subset of chats are reviewed by human reviewers (including Google’s trained service providers) to help improve Google services.
Regardless of your settings, Google uses your chats to respond to you and help protect Google, our users, and the public, including with help from human reviewers.
Please don’t enter confidential information that you wouldn’t want a reviewer to see or Google to use to improve our services, including machine-learning technologies.

ads_sale.summary: Google says Gemini chats are not being used to show you ads, and that it does not sell personal information.

evidence.quote: Your Gemini Apps chats are not being used to show you ads. If this changes, we will clearly communicate it to you.
Google does not sell your personal information.

private_mode.summary: Temporary chats do not appear in your recent chats and are not used to train Google's AI models. Google says they are retained with your account for around two months.

evidence.quote: You can start a temporary chat that won’t appear in your Gemini Apps Activity or your recent chats.
Temporary chats are not used to train Google’s AI models.
Temporary chats and chats you have when your History setting is off are retained with your account for around two months

transparency.summary: Google's privacy policy shows its effective date and links to archived versions.

evidence.quote: Effective October 16, 2026
We always indicate the date the last changes were published and we offer access to archived versions for your review.

business.summary: Google says work and school accounts may be subject to different data handling terms.

evidence.quote: If you have a work or school Google Account, your use of Gemini Apps may be subject to different data handling terms.

opt_out.summary: In Gemini's History settings, uncheck "Chat content including text & uploads". Turning History off entirely also stops training on future chats unless you send feedback.
steps: On a computer, go to gemini.google.com.
At the bottom, open Settings, then History.
Uncheck "Chat content including text & uploads" and click Turn off.

evidence.quote: Next to “Chat content including text & uploads”, check or uncheck the box.
Reviewed chats and related data are retained for up to 3 years, even if you delete them or turn this setting off later.

Even when History is off, your conversations will be saved with your account for around two months to allow Google to provide the service, process any feedback, and protect Google, its users, and the public.

caveats: Google says chats already reviewed by people are kept for up to 3 years even if you turn the setting off later.
With the setting off, Google says future chats are still reviewed and used to improve its services in other ways.
With History off, Google says chats are still saved with your account for around two months.
